units.source_text: 對未來抱有什麼樣的希望呢？

en.t: What kind of hopes do you have for the future?

units.source_text: 照顧一個人有多難，這是被照顧者所無法理解的。」「

en.t: How hard it is to look after someone is something the person being looked after cannot understand.
I am sorry for causing you trouble.
You really have made me worry.

units.source_text: 既然我答應照顧你，就不希望你是一個半途而廢的人。

en.t: Since I agreed to look after you, I do not want you to be someone who gives up halfway.

units.source_text: 我希望看到你邁上正道，有重新做人的覺悟。

en.t: I want to see you set out on the right path and show the resolve to start over.

units.source_text: 比如，你將來的去向，若能誠心誠意地主動跟我商量，

en.t: For example, if you would sincerely come to me on your own to discuss your future course,
I will try to find a way to help you.

units.source_text: 我比目魚畢竟不是有錢人，資助你的能力也很有限，

en.t: After all, I, Hirame, am not a wealthy man, and my ability to support you is limited,

units.source_text: 若你還想過以前的奢侈生活，那我可就幫不上什麼忙了。

en.t: so if you still want to live the extravagant life you had before, there is not much I can do for you.
